name: Hermetica USDh
oneLiner: USDh is Hermetica's BTC-backed synthetic dollar on Stacks, kept near $1 by pairing spot BTC long with equal-size short BTC perpetual futures positions on CEXes.
collateral: Dual yield-engine backing: BTC spot holdings paired with equal short BTC perpetual futures positions on centralized exchanges (delta-neutral), plus STRC digital-credit exposure added in 2026 (Saturn USDat route with Galaxy execution and Clear Street custody, and tokenized STRCx via Backed Assets/Kraken); BTC margin reserves custodied off-exchange via Copper (Clearloop) and Ceffu (MirrorX), with monthly custodian attestations of assets, liabilities and reserve coverage
pegMechanism: Delta-neutral hedging: BTC spot long + equal BTC short perpetual futures neutralize directional exposure; mint and redeem via KYC-gated Hermetica app; DIA oracle provides reserve-backed fair value pricing on Stacks

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Stacks transaction 0x6294eebb5e5560d8293268e2c28d3e9533d890007d8a573be80beb8b0db9ad49 deployed the exact tracked usdh-token-v1 contract at block 166,579 on September 19, 2024. Hermetica's official USDh documentation describes the matched BTC spot-long and perpetual-short backing strategy, supporting the synthetic-delta-neutral archetype.
